name: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Hou
original_name: ひぐらしのなく頃に奉
source:
Although the [url=/r34866]release[/url] for this visual novel also contains all the Higurashi sound novels 07th Expansion previously released, this entry is only concerned with the completely new content featured in the release:

• Higurashi Outbreak
• Higurashi Outbreak ~Kamikashimashi-hen~
• Hinamizawa Bus Stop
• Mehagashi-hen
translation:
虽然本视觉小说的[url=/r34866]发行版[/url]还收录了07th Expansion此前发行的全部《寒蝉鸣泣之时》音声小说，但本条目只介绍其中完全新作的内容：

•《寒蝉鸣泣之时：爆发》
•《寒蝉鸣泣之时：爆发～神灭篇～》
•《雏见泽公交站》
•《梅花柿篇》
